chunks: From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Surely the companions of Musa were tested with a river, and it is the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'Surely Allah will try you with a river.' And surely the companions of the Qaim will be tested in the same way.
ai.seo_question: What is the trial faced by the companions of the Qaim similar to?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) links the trial of Prophet Musa’s companions with drinking from the river (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:249) to the specific test awaiting the companions of the Mahdi (al-Qaim). This parallel underscores that just as the Israelites were tested on their obedience during the journey to the Promised Land, the followers of the Imam in the end times will face a similar trial of patience and fidelity amidst global upheaval.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 491 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Abdur Rahman bin Abu Hashim from Ali bin Abu Hamza from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said: “

The companions of Musa (a.s) were tested by the stream and it is that which the Almighty Allah has said: “Surely Allah will try you with a river…” [2:249] The companions of Qaim (a.s) would also be tested in the same way.
